limits: correlated query land patches and overlapping supports; no independent-scene or independence claim

not CLAP/FroFA reproduction or novel theory
mandatory: all fixed strategies, both budgets, every episode; harmful frequency separately vs weak/RA; posthoc best regret only diagnostic

selected minus RA full-fit query accuracy
